messages:
jamie: Weekly release train update — window opens TOMORROW 10:00 UTC. Quick TL;DR: core runtime v2.3.1, batching improvements, and experimental KV-cache metrics shipped to canary. Please read below for rollouts and freeze notes.

release-bot: CI status: master build ✅, canary pipeline running (3/4 stages passed). Canary deployment started at 1711200120. Link: <https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/8234>

sophia: Noted — I'll monitor latency dashboards during canary. Added a smoke test to the canary job for long-seq workloads.

jamie: Rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full over 48h. Auto-rollback on error rate >1.5% or p95 increase >30%.

oliver: Saw a small spike in tokenization errors in the first canary host at 1711200180. Logs: ```ERROR Tokenizer: unknown token sequence at /mnt/models/gptx/handler.cpp:412``` Investigating root cause, might be a model artifact.

praveen: Can we gate the 10% step until tokenizer fix is verified? Requesting hold.

jamie: Hold acknowledged. Pausing progression to 10%. Can we get a patch by EOD?

maria: I pushed a small fix (PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/542>) that normalizes input encoding. Running upstream tests now.

release-bot: PR 542 build succeeded at 1711200305. Canary redeploy queued.

jamie: OK — once canary stabilizes for 30m with p95 and error rate within SLO, we resume 10% push. Everyone on call at 09:30 UTC to confirm.

sophia: Reminder: release freeze window starts Friday 00:00 UTC for the client SDK freeze. No new features to main after that unless emergency change. Exceptions require @jamie approval and release-owner signoff.

oliver: For visibility — metrics to watch: inference_p95_latency, token_error_rate, batch_fill_ratio. Dashboards: <https://dashboards.redwood/inference/release-12>

praveen: I'll add a synthetic workload that mirrors our largest customer traffic to the canary for 1h smoke.

jamie: Action items: 1) praveen run synthetic (in progress), 2) maria confirm fix on canary for 30m, 3) sophia keep an eye on p95 and paging rules, 4) oliver prepare rollback notes if tokenizer issue recurs.

maria: Canary stable for 35m. No new tokenization errors. p95 back to baseline.

release-bot: Canary promotion to 10% started at 1711200380.

oliver: 👍 monitoring.

jamie: If anyone sees anomalies after promotion, post here and tag @jamie immediately. Otherwise we follow normal cadence and aim for 50% in 6h. Good work team :tada:

sophia: Noted and will run post-promotion perf check at +15m and +60m.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll prepare release notes draft for product and ops channels.

jamie: End of thread — concise roll call tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
